title: Teddy And Peddy Went Into Jungle
custom_script:
# Scene: home (sitting)
Peddy: {yay} Teddy! Pack your bag. We are going to the *jungle*! [happy, wave, excited, ding]
Teddy: {haan} The jungle? With lions and snakes? No, thank you. [surprised, shrug]
Peddy: {hmm} There is a hidden *treasure* there. A golden *banana*! [suspicious, point, whisper]
Teddy: {wow} A golden banana? {love} Why didn't you say that first? [happy, wave, excited]
Peddy: Because you always eat everything first! {facepalm} [angry, hips]
Teddy: {giggle} True. Okay, I am bringing ten *samosas*. For energy. [happy, idle, eat]
Peddy: {uff} Ten? We need a *map*, not a buffet! [sad, shrug, fail]
Teddy: {ohoo} Relax. My stomach is my map. {laugh} [happy, point, laugh]
# Scene: street
Peddy: {look-around} Okay, the jungle bus leaves in two minutes! [surprised, point, excited]
Teddy: {phone} Wait, let me take a *selfie* first. [happy, wave]
Peddy: {haan} Teddy! The {show:bus} *bus* is leaving! [angry, point, shout, horn]
Teddy: {aah} Wait for us, Mister Bus! {jump} [surprised, wave, shout, footsteps]
Peddy: {uff} We missed it. Because of your *selfie*. [sad, hips, fail]
Teddy: {idea} No problem. We will walk! It is only… *fifty* kilometers. [happy, point, ding]
Peddy: {dizzy} Fifty?! My legs are crying already. [sad, shrug, cry]
Teddy: {giggle} Then let your legs cry while we walk! {walk-out} [happy, wave, footsteps]
# Time skip: Five hours later…
# Scene: park
Peddy: {aah} Finally! The *jungle*! Smell that fresh air! {sniff} [happy, wave, excited]
Teddy: {sniff} Hmm… I smell *samosas*. Oh wait, that's my bag. [happy, idle]
Peddy: {look-around} Shhh. Did you hear that? Something is in the *trees*. [suspicious, think, whisper]
Teddy: {scared} Is it a lion? Please say it's not a lion! [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Peddy: {gasp} It's a {show:monkey} *monkey*! [surprised, point, gasp]
Teddy: {wow} Aww, he is so cute! {love} Hello, little buddy! [happy, wave]
Peddy: {haan} Teddy… he took your *bag*! [surprised, point, shout, whoosh]
Teddy: MY SAMOSAS! {angry} Come back, you thief! [angry, point, shout, angry]
# Scene: park
Teddy: {cry} He ate all ten. All ten *samosas*. [sad, shrug, cry]
Peddy: {facepalm} I told you to bring a *map*, not snacks. [sad, hips]
Teddy: {hmm} Okay, okay. Where is the map, genius? [suspicious, hips, calm]
Peddy: {look-around} It was… in your bag. [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Teddy: {ohoo} So the monkey has our *map* too! [angry, point, shout]
Peddy: {oops} Now the monkey will find the golden banana. {sweat} [surprised, shrug, fail]
Teddy: {think} Wait. A monkey… with a map… finding a banana? {laugh} That's perfect for him! [happy, think]
Peddy: {uff} Not funny! Come on, follow those *footprints*. [angry, wave, footsteps]
# Scene: park
Peddy: {look-around} The footprints stop here. Next to this *river*. [suspicious, think]
Teddy: {hmm} Peddy… why is that log *smiling* at us? [suspicious, point, whisper]
Peddy: {gasp} That's not a log! That's a {show:crocodile} *crocodile*! [surprised, point, shout, scream]
Teddy: {aah} RUN, PEDDY, RUN! {jump} [surprised, wave, shout, footsteps]
Peddy: {scared} I can't run! My shoe is *stuck*! [surprised, shrug, shout]
Teddy: {idea} Throw him your *shoe*! Crocodiles love shoes! [happy, point, ding]
Peddy: {haan} Who told you that?! [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {giggle} Nobody. But look, it worked! He is eating it! [happy, point, eat]
Peddy: {uff} Great. Now I have *one* shoe in a jungle. [sad, shrug, fail]
# Time skip: One hour later…
# Scene: park
Teddy: {dizzy} I'm so hungry. I can see *pizza* everywhere. [sad, shrug]
Peddy: {facepalm} Teddy, that's a *rock*. Please don't lick it. [angry, hips, calm]
Teddy: {sniff} It smells like cheese… a little bit. [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {look-around} Wait. Look up! {show:parrot} A *parrot*! [surprised, point, excited]
Teddy: {wow} Hello, Mister Parrot! Do you know where the golden banana is? [happy, wave]
Peddy: {hmm} Teddy, parrots can't give directions. [suspicious, hips, calm]
Teddy: {gasp} He is flying that way! He is helping us! [surprised, point, excited, whoosh]
Peddy: {ohoo} Or he is just going home. {shrug} Fine, let's follow him. [normal, shrug]
# Scene: park
Peddy: {sweat} It's getting dark. We need a place to *sleep*. [sad, shrug, whisper]
Teddy: {yay} Camping! I love camping! I'll make a *fire*! [happy, wave, excited]
Peddy: {hmm} Do you know how to make a fire? [suspicious, hips, calm]
Teddy: {phone} Yes. I watched one *video*. Thirty seconds. [happy, point]
Peddy: {facepalm} That's not experience, that's a *reel*! [angry, hips, shout]
Teddy: {clap} Look! Smoke! Smoke! I did it! [happy, wave, excited, magic]
Peddy: {gasp} Teddy, that smoke is coming from your *socks*! [surprised, point, shout, scream]
Teddy: {aah} HOT HOT HOT! {jump} {dance} [surprised, wave, shout, boing]
# Time skip: Midnight…
# Scene: park
Teddy: {scared} Peddy… are you awake? [surprised, idle, whisper]
Peddy: {wake} Now I am. What is it? [angry, hips, whisper]
Teddy: {look-around} Something big is breathing behind me. [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Peddy: {hmm} It's just the *wind*. Go to sleep. [normal, idle, calm]
Teddy: {gasp} The wind has *teeth*?! [surprised, point, shout]
Peddy: {aah} It's a {show:tiger} *TIGER*! [surprised, wave, shout, scream]
Teddy: {idea} Stay calm! Tigers hate *singing*! [happy, point, ding]
Peddy: {haan} Then SING, Teddy! SING! [angry, point, shout]
Teddy: {dance} La la laaa… I am a happy *teddy*… [happy, wave, excited, drumroll]
Peddy: {wow} He is running away! Your singing is a *weapon*! [happy, point, laugh]
# Scene: park
Peddy: {wake} Good morning, jungle! {yay} We survived the night! [happy, wave, excited]
Teddy: {uff} Barely. My voice is gone after all that *singing*. [sad, shrug, calm]
Peddy: {look-around} Look! The {show:parrot} parrot is back! And he is pointing! [surprised, point, excited]
Teddy: {gasp} He is pointing at that big *cave*! [surprised, point]
Peddy: {hmm} A dark cave in the jungle. What could go wrong? [suspicious, think, whisper]
Teddy: {giggle} Everything. But… golden banana! [happy, wave, excited]
Peddy: {nod} For the golden banana! {walk-out} [happy, point, footsteps]
# Scene: plain
Teddy: {scared} It's so dark in here. I can't see my own *nose*. [surprised, shrug, whisper]
Peddy: {phone} Use your phone *light*. [normal, point, calm]
Teddy: {oops} Battery is two percent. Because of the *selfies*. [sad, shrug, fail]
Peddy: {facepalm} Of course it is. {uff} [angry, hips]
Teddy: {gasp} Peddy… I see something shining! [surprised, point, magic]
Peddy: {wow} It's gold! It's the GOLDEN BANANA! [happy, wave, shout, applause]
Teddy: {yay} We are *rich*! We are so rich! {dance} [happy, wave, excited, cash]
Peddy: {haan} Wait. Who is holding it? [suspicious, think, whisper]
# Scene: plain
Teddy: {gasp} It's the {show:monkey} *monkey*! The samosa thief! [surprised, point, shout]
Peddy: {angry} Give us that banana, you little *thief*! [angry, point, shout, angry]
Teddy: {hmm} Wait… he is holding our *map* too. [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {look-around} And… he drew a *heart* on it. {love} [surprised, shrug]
Teddy: {ohoo} He found the treasure for us! He is our *friend*! [happy, wave, excited]
Peddy: {cry} Aww. I feel bad for calling him a thief. [sad, shrug, cry]
Teddy: {nod} Me too. Can I have my *samosas* back, buddy? [happy, wave]
Peddy: {laugh} Teddy, he ate them yesterday! [happy, point, laugh]
# Scene: park
Peddy: {look-around} Okay, now we just need to go *home*. [normal, point]
Teddy: {gasp} With what? We don't have a map, a bus, or *shoes*! [surprised, shrug, shout]
Peddy: {hmm} Hey, I still have *one* shoe. [suspicious, think]
Teddy: {giggle} Great. Half of you can go home. [happy, point, laugh]
Peddy: {idea} Wait! The {show:elephant} *elephant*! Maybe he can give us a ride! [happy, point, ding]
Teddy: {wow} An elephant taxi! Best day ever! [happy, wave, excited, horn]
Peddy: {jump} Hold on tight, Teddy! [happy, wave, excited, boing]
Teddy: {aah} I'm too high! I'm too *HIGH*! [surprised, wave, shout, scream]
# Time skip: The next morning…
# Scene: home (sitting)
Peddy: {yay} Home sweet home! And we have the *golden banana*! [happy, wave, excited, applause]
Teddy: {hmm} Peddy… why is it getting *soft*? [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {haan} Soft? Gold doesn't get soft! [surprised, hips, shout]
Teddy: {sniff} It smells like… a real *banana*. Painted gold. [suspicious, think]
Peddy: {shock} We walked fifty kilometers… for a painted *banana*?! [angry, point, shout, fail]
Teddy: {eat} Well… it's a very tasty *treasure*. {giggle} [happy, idle, eat]
Peddy: {facepalm} Next time, I'm going alone. [sad, shrug, calm]
Teddy: {ohoo} Next time… let's go to the *desert*! {laugh} [happy, wave, excited, laugh]
